reconcile.note: Gill distinguishes creation's proof that God exists and possesses some perfections from full comprehension of his nature, which Job and Isaiah deny is attainable.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible sets Romans 1:20's claim that God is plainly seen in creation directly against Job 11:7's denial that searching can find him out.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: Can you fathom the mystery of God?
sides.verseText: \"Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

sides.snippet: the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen
sides.verseText: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.
